About Bay Breeze Realty

Our Story

Built on patient teaching, not pressure

Bay Breeze Realty started from a simple frustration: watching everyday buyers get rushed, outbid, and talked down to by traditional corporate brokerages. Founded by former educators, we brought a teaching-first mentality to the East Bay, breaking down complex contracts and waterfront market trends into plain English.

Today, our team guides first-time buyers and local families across Alameda, Oakland, and nearby waterfront neighborhoods. We skip the aggressive sales pitches and corporate jargon, focusing instead on honest advice, free library classes, and weekend open house crawls that make the process fun.

We believe homebuying should feel empowering, not intimidating. Our office in Alameda is always open when you want to talk strategy without any rush.
